messages:
emily: Heads-up — seeing a sharp drop in prefix-cache hit-rate on the kernel-v3 canary (dedicated-prod). Graph: https://grafana.redwood/board/abc123 :thinking_face:

sanjay: On it. Which metric and hostpool?

emily: prefix_cache.hitrate.top1k and prefix_cache.hitrate.global across canary nodes. Before deploy it was ~83%, now ~61% for same prompt set. Appears correlated with SDK streaming retries.

kev: Any evidence it's a keying problem vs eviction?

emily: Profile shows a lot of identical prompts hashed to different keys — the only difference is an ephemeral header: `x-rw-stream-id` included by SDK for chunked streams. Those values are unique per connection, so misses are expected.

mae: Yikes. Keying code currently canonicalizes headers but includes 'all-xs-headers' list. Runtime file: runtime/cache/prefix_key.cc. We intentionally added some header hashing to help multitenancy, but this is too broad.

sanjay: I can whip up a diff to exclude `x-rw-stream-id` and any known transient headers. Also add a header ignore-list in config.

ops-bot: deploy started: cache-key-ignore-ephemeral -> canary (5% nodes)

ryan: Quick snapshot: after the canary deploy we saw a small bump on those nodes (+3-5%) but overall cluster still low. There's another factor: kernel selection changed in kernel-v3's dynamic batching which leads to more partials and client retries that re-hash.

kev: Are retries being marked? If retries get a different kernel (due to missing sequence_hint) then KV cache reuse fails even if keying is fixed. SDKs sometimes resend without copying all original headers.

mae: Proposal snippet:
```
# canonicalization plan
X-Redwood-Cache-Optin: true
X-Redwood-Idempotency: <orig-req-id>
ignore_headers: [ "x-rw-stream-id", "x-sdk-trace", "cookie", "x-client-resume" ]
```
We should canonicalize request metadata before hashing prompt+prefix.

sanjay: Found another issue — scheduler picks different kernel on retry because `sequence_length_hint` isn't preserved in retry path. That leads to different quantized kernels and incompatible KV layouts.

ryan: Recommended sequence: 1) runtime: ignore ephemeral headers + preserve sequence_hint on retry, 2) SDK: stop sending ephemeral stream id on retries, add cacheOpt flag, 3) edge: hotfix to canonicalize headers while SDK update propagates, 4) observability: add cache_hit_by_request_id.

emily: Also want a small API/SDK change: introduce `cacheOpt` boolean in SDK request options (default false) and an opt-in header `X-Redwood-Cache-Optin: true`. This avoids accidental caching of non-idempotent/resumable streams.

mae: PR opened for runtime header ignore + sequence_hint carry: https://git.redwood/runtime/pull/4387 (in review). SDK patch to stop adding `x-rw-stream-id` on retries is in progress.

kev: Can we apply a proxy-level filter to strip ephemeral headers now? Might buy time while SDKs roll out.

ops-bot: patch applied to edge-proxy-1: header-stripper v2.0 -> warmup-hitrate +4% in last 10m on proxied nodes

ryan: Note on streaming/resume semantics: some clients resume with tokens embedded in prompt text (`... resume=12345`). We should also normalize prompts by stripping resume tokens before hashing. Otherwise identical prompts with different resume tokens will miss.

sanjay: I'll add regex to strip `resume=[0-9A-Za-z_-]+` from prompt bodies prior to hashing and include a unit test.

mae: One UX improvement: add `cacheable: true/false` in response metadata so the SDK can avoid blind retries for non-cacheable responses.

kev: Next actions and owners:
- sanjay: runtime patch for ignore-list + prompt normalization + sequence_hint carry (ETA 24h)
- mae: SDK `cacheOpt` flag + stop sending `x-rw-stream-id` on retries (ETA 48h)
- ops: roll proxy strip globally (in progress)
- ryan: dashboards + alert (hitrate <70% for 5m) + metric `cache_hit_by_request_id`

emily: :thumbsup: Good plan. Sanjay can you add the canary link to the PR so perf reviewers can correlate?

sanjay: Will do, PR updated and linked. Patch in review now. ETA ~24h.

kev: Thanks all. Small ask: add a short note to SDK changelog about new `X-Redwood-Cache-Optin` header so integrators know how to opt-in for caching.

emily: Agreed. We'll triage any customer reports during rollout.

ops-bot: monitor note: alert created `redwood.cache.hitrate.low` -> paging on callgroup infra-oncall if >5m

mae: Added unit tests and a tiny perf microbenchmark in runtime that shows normalized hashing recovers ~18% of misses in synthetic workload. Test gist linked in PR.

ryan: I'll keep watching metrics and post a follow-up once SDK patch is live.

emily: Thanks everyone — keep updates here.
